text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #2345 touches .github/CODEOWNERS and the CI workflow in infra/.github/workflows/ci.yaml. Need to confirm who can approve the CODEOWNERS change before I merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345

sam: can you paste the CODEOWNERS lines changed?

alex: sure, diff is small:
```
.github/CODEOWNERS
# root owners
/docs/ @docs-team
.github/ @eng-platform @infra
infra/ci/ @infra
```
maria: So the file lists @eng-platform and @infra as owners of .github. That usually means either a member of eng-platform or infra can approve, but workflow edits triggering org-level CI often require a platform reviewer too (security/ops).

jane: I can sign off on the infra side. Quick Q: does the workflow change add any new external actions or tokens?

alex: no new external actions, just toggles a conditional and fixes a path that was previously a symlink. No secrets added.

jane: OK I can approve once CI is green. @sam — could you take a quick look at the workflow change from a platform perspective? It's touching a reusable job we own.

sam: on it, pinged in the PR with two tiny suggestions. :eyes:

sam: LGTM overall but left one nit about job timeout (commented). Not blocking.

alex: great — plan: jane + sam approvals, wait for CI. If both green, I'll merge in ~5–10m.

infra-bot: CI passed for commit 9f3b7a2 (all checks green) :white_check_mark:

jane: :thumbsup: approving now.

sam: approving as well.

alex: merging now. thanks everyone! :rocket:

maria: thanks for coordinating — good to call out cross-owner PRs like this in the future in the PR description.

alex: will do.
